title: Gemini 4 Argon
raw_excerpt: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier model built for sustained reasoning across software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and cybersecurity. Access is initially limited to trusted cyber defenders, with broader availability planned after phased safety testing.
summary: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon，定位为面向软件工程、企业知识工作与网络安全的前沿模型，主打长时持续推理能力。初期仅向受信任的网络安全防御者开放，待分阶段安全测试后再扩大可用范围。这是谷歌在 Gemini 4 系列上的又一重要落子，选择从安全领域切入而非全面开放，反映出前沿模型发布策略正转向「先受控、后普及」，对关注模型能力边界与安全治理的读者值得跟踪。

title: 谷歌Gemini 4突然发布！RSI加持，GPT和Opus都让让
summary: 量子位报道谷歌 Gemini 4 突然发布，称其具备 RSI（递归自我改进）加持，性能压过 GPT 与 Opus 系列，且价格仅为 Astra 的一半。若属实，这意味着谷歌在推理能力与成本效率上同时取得突破，直接冲击 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的定价体系。对开发者和企业选型而言，性价比拐点比单纯的榜单分数更具实际意义，值得关注后续第三方评测验证。

title: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
raw_excerpt: A pop-up shop for "dots," a personal assistant agent at OpenAI DevDay 2026. (Photo by Heather Diehl/Getty Images) | Getty Images At OpenAI's annual DevDay conference, the company pulled out all the stops to compete with its rivals - primarily Meta, whose Muse AI agent platform has seen early runaway success. CEO Sam Altman walked onstage to cheers and announced Dots, a "real-deal AI" agent powered by GPT-6 Astra, "inspired by the cool agents that we all watched in movies growing up." Similar to Muse, Dots aims for disarming cuteness, taking the form of colorful, personalizable blobs with eyes. OpenAI fired shots at Meta by demonstrating Dots' ability to not just act as helpful assistants but build metaverse-esque virtual worlds. But in one key area, Dots strikingly fa … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI 在年度 DevDay 上发布个人助理智能体 Dots，由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动，形态是可个性化定制的彩色「小团子」，明显对标 Meta 早期大获成功的 Muse 平台。The Verge 分析指出，OpenAI 此举是对 Meta 的直接反击，但核心悬念在于：面对 Meta 的免费策略，付费智能体能否竞争。这标志着消费级 AI 助手竞争从模型能力转向产品形态与商业模式之争。

title: An AI “mind-reading” tool can reconstruct what you’re looking at from a brain scan
raw_excerpt: A new AI tool can guess what you’re looking at just by analyzing your brain scans—and re-create that image with remarkable precision. It can go the other way, too, and predict a person’s brain activity based on what they’re looking at. In the image above, for example, the left-hand image of each pair is what the user actually saw—and its right-hand counterpart is what the model reconstructed from the brain scan. Michal Irani, who developed the tool with her colleagues at the Weizmann Institute of Science in Rehovot, Israel, hopes her “mind-reading” tool will ultimately reveal more about how the brain works, and could perhaps be used to help locked-in people communicate, or allow scientists to re-create the content of dreams. Judy Illes, a neuroethicist and professor of neurology at the University of British Columbia in Canada, who was not involved in the research, describes the work as “magnificent.” “The idea [of using this approach] to help people with neurologic conditions … therapeutically is tremendously exciting,” she says. But other scientists warn that a similar approach could be used to reveal people’s inner thoughts and mental imagery, potentially without their consent. “The results seem very impressive,” says Tommy Sprague, a neuroscientist at the University of California, Santa Barbara. “But if there’s a way to surreptitiously extract information about what you’re thinking about, then …150 years of sci-fi can come true anytime, and that’s worrisome in a lot of wa…
summary: 以色列魏茨曼科学研究所 Michal Irani 团队开发出 AI「读心」工具，仅凭脑部扫描即可高精度重建受试者所看的图像，反向也能根据图像预测脑活动。研究团队希望该工具能揭示大脑工作机制，并帮助闭锁综合征患者沟通。这是脑机接口与神经科学交叉领域的重要进展，双向预测能力意味着模型学到了视觉表征的共享结构，而不只是单向拟合。

title: 何恺明团队新作：看猫片就能学会ARC挑战
summary: 何恺明团队新作显示，仅用 ImageNet 训练 encoder 就能让模型学会应对 ARC 挑战。ARC 一直被视为检验抽象推理能力的试金石，此前多数方法依赖专门设计的归纳偏置或大规模合成数据。该工作表明通用视觉预训练本身可能蕴含可迁移的推理能力，为「视觉预训练能否通向通用智能」这一争论提供了新的实证，对推理与表征学习方向的研究者有直接参考价值。

title: Praxis-1
raw_excerpt: Praxis-1 is an open-weight world action model that turns Runway's video pretraining into control for real robots. The model is currently being tested with early partners, each running on their own hardware. It will be released publicly in the coming months. Clips of robots running the model are available in the post.
summary: Runway 发布 Praxis-1，一个开放权重的「世界动作模型」，把其视频预训练能力转化为真实机器人的控制策略。目前正与早期合作方在各自硬件上测试，计划未来数月公开发布。这是视频生成公司向具身智能延伸的代表性动作：用海量视频学到的物理直觉直接驱动机械臂，绕开传统机器人数据的稀缺瓶颈，对具身智能路线选择有参考意义。

title: FTC is investigating OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI companies over product risks
summary: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）正就产品风险问题调查 OpenAI、Anthropic 等多家 AI 公司。这是继各州层面动作之后，美国联邦监管机构对前沿 AI 企业展开的正式调查，焦点在于产品对消费者可能造成的危害。结合加州对 OpenAI 发出调查传票，可以看出监管压力正从立法讨论转向具体执法，对 AI 公司的合规成本与发布节奏将产生实质影响。

title: GPT-Synopsys: Frontier Intelligence to Revolutionize Chip Design
summary: OpenAI 与 EDA 巨头 Synopsys 联合发布 GPT-Synopsys，宣称以「前沿智能」革新芯片设计。这是大模型厂商首次与主流芯片设计工具链深度绑定，意味着 AI 开始切入半导体研发这一高壁垒、长周期的核心环节。若能在 RTL 生成、验证与布局优化上带来实际提效，其产业影响将远超一般应用层合作，值得半导体与 AI 基础设施从业者密切关注。

title: Can we predict the jobs robots will do?
raw_excerpt: Robots currently can perform 74% of US physical job tasks, yet are cost-effective for only 0.3% due to high expenses.
summary: Anthropic 研究给出量化答案：当前机器人已能完成美国体力类工作任务的 74%，但受成本所限，真正具备经济可行性的仅占 0.3%。这组数据把「机器人替代」的讨论从能力问题拉回到成本问题——技术可行与经济可行之间存在巨大鸿沟。对判断自动化落地节奏、评估劳动力市场冲击时点而言，这一区分比单纯的「能做什么」更有决策价值。

title: Introducing Olmo-core 3: Open, scalable training infrastructure for large MoEs
summary: Allen AI 发布 Olmo-core 3，一套面向大规模 MoE 模型的开放、可扩展训练基础设施。在大模型训练日益被少数巨头垄断的背景下，开源训练栈的意义在于降低复现门槛，让学术界与中小团队也能训练混合专家架构。该工作延续了 Olmo 系列「全开放」的路线，对关注训练效率、MoE 工程实现与开源生态的研究者和工程师具有直接使用价值。
